name: ULME arbitrary approved-user spending
summary: buyMiner(user, usdt) was public and passed its caller-supplied user directly to USDT.transferFrom without requiring user == msg.sender or another authorization. The attacker invoked it for 100 holders who had approved ULME, forcing their USDT through the ULME/USDT pair while sandwiching those trades.
notes: An internal setRoter() call set the PancakeSwap router in slot 0xe and USDT in slot 0xd. Before this transaction buyMiner had zero-valued swap dependencies; this configuration made its arbitrary approved-user spending path operational.

The exploit receipt contains 100 USDT transfers from distinct approved users to ULME totaling 250,817.770742650963321153 USDT, followed by the same total from ULME to the pair. The users received no asset in return. The pair's 200,170.825418687386914428 USDT transaction-local net inflow and the attacker's roughly $50,000 sandwich profit are consequences of these forced trades, not alternative measures of the users' gross loss.
